strategic_goal: one headless dedicated server and at least two ordinary graphical Godot clients using one production gameplay path
historical_track_note: M1-M6 are the single-server multiplayer track; historical M0 remains the accepted multi-aggregate transaction checkpoint

transport_policy.server_to_server_after_A3: NATS Core through B0 semantic ports
transport_policy.forbidden: NATS must not replace ENet graphical client traffic or create a second gameplay path

milestones.name: Unified Networked Gameplay Core
acceptance: listen-host and dedicated ENet use one NetworkedGameplayService
shared wire DTO validators are independent from authority implementations
same command produces the same canonical state across loopback and ENet
H1-H3 tests use the common service without topology-specific domain forks
client and UI receive no authoritative references

milestones.name: Dedicated server plus one graphical client
acceptance: game-client graphical role connects without embedded authority
stable player identity and initial synchronization
authoritative movement and correction
inventory and hotbar are replica-driven
reconnect restores the same player entity

milestones.name: Dedicated server plus two graphical clients
acceptance: two ordinary graphical clients connect simultaneously
local and remote player presentation are distinct
both clients observe authoritative movement of the other
remote presentation has no input authority
one client disconnect does not stop the other

milestones.name: Canonical shared gameplay over ENet
acceptance: full H1 Item Graph is used by dedicated multiplayer
inventory hotbar pickup drop stack split containers mount detach are authoritative
contention produces exactly one success and one deterministic rejection
canonical Item Graph contains exactly one stable item identity
foreign inventory mutation and stale session commands are rejected

milestones.name: Graphical Multiplayer Acceptance
acceptance: automated dedicated plus two graphical client process scenario
real renderer or virtual display; headless-only clients are insufficient
movement observation contention disconnect reconnect all pass
server and both clients converge to one canonical checksum
separate user-data directories and clean process shutdown

milestones.name: Dedicated persistence and recovery
acceptance: dedicated crash and restart restore world players inventories and Item Graph
operation ledger revisions authority epoch and committed outbox state recover
no item duplication after restart
clients reconnect with updated ownership epochs
committed operations replay without second mutation

milestones.name: Single-server multiplayer architecture audit/freeze
acceptance: M1-M6 accepted
one production gameplay service and one family of wire contracts
two graphical clients pass canonical Item Graph contention
reconnect replay and dedicated recovery are proven
no topology-specific gameplay forks
B1 scope is server-to-server only

milestones.name: NATS Core adapter
milestones.scope: server-to-server discovery heartbeat health load capability discovery and request/reply through B0 ports

multi_server_entry_criterion: two reproducible graphical clients, authoritative movement, canonical shared Item Graph, deterministic contention, disconnect/reconnect and crash recovery without topology-specific gameplay forks
